name: Old Government House, Brisbane
scope: Old Government House at Gardens Point, Brisbane, in the appearance recorded by the early published color photographs. Includes the sandstone residence, southeast carriage portico, two-storey garden arcades and attached rear ranges. Excludes neighboring campus buildings, garden features and later fit-out.

originalReview.notes: Carriage entrance shows the pale projecting porch, triangular gable, three tall upper sashes, four front columns, arched lower bays and upper balcony.
Garden elevation shows wraparound lower sandstone arcades, slender upper veranda posts, shallow roof and rounded pavilion. Tree occlusion leaves some bays uncertain.

review.method: Exact published Qualla originals with native Commons SHA-1, pinned revisions and explicit photographer public-domain dedications
review.notes: Two exact Qualla originals were accepted. The original author and uploader match the public-domain dedications. The September 2005 upload bounds the documented appearance; precise exposure dates are unknown. The archival 1879 photograph was excluded from the early color reconstruction.
